description: Header file defining classes for network simulation links (OneWayLink and SymmetricLink) in the quiche/quic test tools, including their interfaces, constructors, and member functions.

classes.name: OneWayLink
classes.description: A reliable simplex network link with constrained bandwidth and random delay, used in network simulation.

classes.name: SymmetricLink
classes.description: A full-duplex network link composed of two OneWayLink instances, representing bidirectional communication.

methods.name: AcceptPacket
methods.description: Accepts a packet for transmission over the link.

methods.name: TimeUntilAvailable
methods.description: Returns the time until the link is available for the next packet.

methods.name: Act
methods.description: Performs scheduled actions for the link, such as transmitting packets.

methods.name: GetRandomDelay
methods.description: Returns a random delay to be added to packet transmission, can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: ScheduleNextPacketDeparture
methods.description: Schedules the next packet to leave the link.

methods.name: set_bandwidth
methods.description: Sets the bandwidth of the link.
